item.description: Dhurandhar continues to storm the box office despite the new release, Avatar: Fire and Ash, this weekend. item.description: Avatar: Fire and Ash kicked off its box office journey on a positive note. item.description: Kalyan Padala has emerged as the winner of Bigg Boss Telugu Season 9, bringing an end to the Nagarjuna-hosted reality show’s nearly four-month journey.
